verdict.rationale: MX's marketing claims a consumer-facing experience where users "ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer." That is a natural-language interface of the product itself, but it is a single marketing line with no documentation of how it works or what commands are supported. The MCP server probe is a separate agent-integration capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command interface (scope, supported actions, setup), any NL control for operators or developers over the Platform API or Client Dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Provide an experience where consumers can ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer, with every figure pulled from real permissioned data.
